name: PICBench — Baseline Functional Pass@1
protocol: PICBench v1 fixed 24 tasks, baseline API prompt, zero feedback, five samples, functional Pass@1; restrictions, feedback, syntax-only and Pass@5 are excluded.

explanation.en: A sample passes only when it executes in SAX and its frequency response agrees with the expert golden design; Pass@1 uses five samples per task.
explanation.zh: 只有 netlist 在 SAX 中可执行且频率响应与专家 golden design 一致时才通过；Pass@1 使用每题五次样本估计。

summary.en: PICBench evaluates simulation-ready photonic integrated-circuit netlist generation.
summary.zh: PICBench 评估模型生成可仿真的光子集成电路 netlist 的能力。

task_format.en: Given a PIC specification and SAX API, the model generates a JSON netlist of components, parameters, ports, and connections.
task_format.zh: 模型根据 PIC 规格和 SAX API，生成包含器件、参数、端口和连接的 JSON netlist。
